response.reason: The photo does not clearly show a readable brand/model mark, and the keyboard's price tier depends heavily on confirming it is indeed a Yamaha PSR-730 versus a generic or different model; a clear model/serial shot and a power-on clip are needed before even a worst-case price can be set.
